title: Textile Casual Lace-Up Shoes with Rubber Outsole and Moulded Quarter Panels for Wholesale Shoe Buyers
highlights:
Textile upper with moulded overlays: Open knit zones combine with shaped quarter and heel panels for a layered casual sneaker profile.

Cord-lock fastening: The toggle holds the front cord at the chosen tension without a conventional lace knot.

A grip for entry: The pull loop provides a place to hold the shoe while guiding the foot into the opening.
